listing.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A (PokeZ-ARecomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Pokémon Legends: Z-A port derived from LAS, translating AArch64 code to C/x64 with Vulkan. The project reports only Windows/NVIDIA play, with partial Lumiose exploration and battles. Black flashes and night-wall stripes remain; a complete playthrough is unconfirmed. The Windows ZIP launcher is described as a game-free player, generator, importer and compiler that imports and recompiles your own files locally once. Windows 10 v1903+/11 x64 needs Vulkan 1.3; AVX2 is preferred, with a slower SSE4.2 fallback. Inherited Linux/Mac builds are untested for Z-A. Use your own version 1.0.0 base XCI/NSP, optional 2.0.0 update and owned DLC, with prod.keys/title.keys. Firmware fonts are optional; the Windows fallback lacks button icons. Back up before save conversion: 2.0.0 saves cannot load on 1.0.0. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
